fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META) stock price declined 2.5% following Italy's €805 million fine, with the fine representing 0.47% of Q3 revenue, regulatory impact priced in.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta maintains 2026 capex guidance in the range of $135–145 million, but risks of weakened ad signals exist if photo-based engagement declines, with 29% undervaluation versus GF value.
